about: The SDK's files, their release profiles and their origin. sdk/package.py reads this and nothing else to decide what a zip holds; sc-offline's tools/sdk-headers.py reads public_header from it. Every file under the folders in 'covers' must be listed here or in 'excluded'.

core.about: The game-neutral plugin SDK: the sco_api ABI, the host services, the C, C++, C# and Lua layers, examples and tools.

game-sc.about: The optional Star Citizen extension: the game pack's service tables and events, DataCore, their C++ and C# wrappers, game examples and docs. Unpack over the core SDK of the version it names.

legacy.about: Everything in one zip, as sdk-v1.1.0 shipped. Not game-neutral. Kept until consumers move to core + game-sc.

core-source.about: Kernel source-development archive: host/runtime, native and Lua loaders, required vendored code, CMake, tools and synthetic tests. No game implementation, contracts, game examples or game-only test fixtures.

host-source-sc.about: Standalone Star Citizen host source kit in repository layout: neutral kernel plus complete game implementation, DataCore, vendored build dependencies, headers and synthetic tests. Included in SDK 2.1.0 candidate scope; publication requires separate signed-byte approval.
